highlighted_text.text: Theranos’ revolutionary lab services make tests more efficient, convenient, and affordable than ever before
Theranos lab tests are available in forty-two Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area, and Theranos is now expanding throughout the state

The legislation that enabled this change makes Arizona the first state to institute this comprehensive framework for laboratory testing, expressly recognizing individual’s rights to their own health information
Theranos brings a much needed innovative technology to the healthcare industry
Lab test data drive more than 70% of health decisions
Theranos, Inc. is a consumer health technology company founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes

facts: Arizona passed a Direct Access law allowing individuals to directly pay for laboratory tests without a physician's order or insurance eligibility.
The law protects physicians from liability associated with individually directed testing.
Theranos lab tests were available in forty-two Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area.
Theranos prices were stated to be always at least 50-80% below Medicare reimbursement rates.
Theranos, Inc. was founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes.
Lab test data drive more than 70% of health decisions according to the text.
